blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: In this report, we introduce pplx-embed-v2-late, a pair of 0.6B and 9B multilingual and multimodal late-interaction models. Both models achieve state-of-the-art results within their respective size classes across a range of text, image, and visual document retrieval benchmarks. On visual document retrieval tasks, pplx-embed-v2-late-0.6b is competitive with models several times larger than itself. The models are trained via representation distillation from an 18B teacher. Consequently, they share an embedding space that supports asymmetric deployment: documents can be indexed with the 9B model and queried with the low-latency 0.6B model. Both models are available at https://huggingface.co/collections/perplexity-ai/pplx-embed-v2.
blocks.zh: 在本报告中,我们引入了pplx-embed-v2-late,一对0.6B和9B多语种和多模式的后期互动模式. 两种模式都在各自的大小类别内,通过一系列文本、图像和可视文件检索基准,取得最新成果。 在可视化文档检索任务上,pplx-embed-v2-late-0.6b与模型的竞争量是自身数倍. 这些模型是通过18B级教师的代理分馏培训的。 因此,它们共享一个支持不对称部署的嵌入空间:文件可以用9B模型编制索引,用低纬度0.6B模型查询。 两种模型均可在https://huggingface.co/collections/perplexity-ai/pplx-embed-v2上查阅.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Retrieval systems face a trade-off between efficiency and the depth of interaction between queries and documents. Dense embeddings interact via cheap inner products, which allow for efficient approximate nearest neighbor search. At the other extreme, cross-encoders process the query and document together, enabling richer interaction but requiring a separate forward pass for every ranked candidate. Late-interaction models ( Khattab and Zaharia, 2020 ) occupy the space between the two. Documents are indexed offline and represented as bags of embedding vectors. These document vectors interact with query vectors via the MaxSim rule, allowing richer interaction than dense embeddings ( Jayaram, 2026 ) .
Late-interaction models have shown especially strong performance in out-of-domain settings ( Santhanam et al., 2022 ; Clavié, 2024 ) , long-context retrieval ( Warner et al., 2025 ; Chaffin, 2025a ; Takehi et al., 2025 ) , agentic search ( Chaffin, 2026 ; Mixedbread Team, 2026 ) , and visual document retrieval (VDR) ( Faysse et al., 2025 ; Günther et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
检索系统面临效率和查询与文件之间互动深度之间的权衡。 Dense嵌入通过廉价的内饰产品进行交互,从而可以高效的近似近邻搜索. 在另一个极端,跨编码者一起处理查询和文档,从而能够进行更丰富的互动,但要求每个排名高的候选人获得单独的前行通行证。 后期互动模式(Khattab和Zaharia,2020年)占据了两者之间的空间. 文档是离线索引,并作为嵌入向量的袋表示。 这些文档向量通过MaxSim规则与查询向量相互作用,允许比密集嵌入更丰富的相互作用(Jayaram, 2026).
后期互动模式在域外环境中表现特别突出 (Santhanam等人,2022年;Clavié,2024年),长文检索. (Warner等人,2025年;Chaffin,2025年a;Takehi等人,2025年),代理搜索(Chaffin,2026年;Mixedbread Team,2026年),和视觉文档检索(VDR)(Faysse等人,2025年;Günther等人,2025年).

blocks.en:
In this report, we introduce pplx-embed-v2-late , a pair of 0.6B and 9B multimodal and multilingual late-interaction models. Both models are distilled at the representation level from a contrastively trained 18B teacher. We find that representation distillation outperforms contrastive training alone, especially at smaller model scales.
Since the 0.6B and 9B models are trained to match the same teacher, the two encoders are interchangeable: a query embedded by the 0.6B model can be scored directly against an index built by the 9B model, and vice versa. This allows for hybrid deployment options where the latency-critical query path can be served by the fast 0.6B model while documents are indexed offline via the stronger 9B model, with the cost of indexing amortized over the lifetime of the index.
Both models individually achieve state-of-the-art performance on a range of text, image, and VDR benchmarks, including ViDoRe-V3 ( Loison et al., 2026 ) .
In concurrent work, Liu et al. (2026) study representation-level distillation in late-interaction models to produce small query encoders. Our work distills query and document token representations into compact multimodal late-interaction models that can serve as both query and document encoders.
blocks.zh:
在本报告中,我们引入了pplx-embed-v2-late,一对0.6B和9B的多式联运和多语种的晚交模式. 这两种模型都是在代表级别上从受过对比性培训的18B教师中提炼出来的. 我们发现,这种代表性蒸馏单是效果优于对比性训练,特别是在较小的模型规模上。
由于0.6B型和9B型是经过训练才能匹配同一老师的,因此这两个编码器是可互换的:一个由0.6B型模式嵌入的查询可以直接比照9B型模式构建的索引打分,反之亦然. 这允许混合部署选项,即快速的0.6B模型可以服务于缓冲关键查询路径,而文件则通过更强的9B模型进行离线索引,在索引存在期间进行索引摊销的成本.
这两个模型都各自在一系列文本,图像,以及VDR基准,包括ViDoRe-V3(Loison等人,2026年)上实现最先进的性能.
在同时工作时,刘等人. (2026)研究后期交互模型中的表示级蒸馏,以产生小查询编码器. 我们的工作将查询和文件符号表示法提炼成可充当查询和文件编码器的紧凑的多式联运晚交模式。

blocks.en: 2 Training
blocks.zh: 2 培训

blocks.en:
In the following, we describe the training procedure for the 18B teacher model and the 9B and 0.6B students.
The teacher model is trained contrastively via an InfoNCE ( van den Oord et al., 2018 ) objective in two stages: first on query-document pairs, then on triplets of queries, relevant documents, and hard negatives.
The students are trained via a pointwise distillation objective similar to that of LEAF ( Vujanic and Rückstieß, 2026 ) to match the embeddings of the teacher. We reuse the pair data from the contrastive training stage for distillation. All of our late-interaction models have 128-dimensional embeddings.
blocks.zh:
下面我们描述18B师范模式和9B和0.6B学生的培训程序.
师范模式通过InfoNCE(van den Oord et al., 2018)目标进行对比培训,分两个阶段进行:首先对查询文件对,然后对查询、相关文件和硬底片进行三进制。
学生通过与LEAF(Vujanic and Rückstieß, 2026年)相似的尖端衍射目标接受培训,以配合老师的嵌入. 我们重用对比性训练阶段的配对数据进行蒸馏。 我们所有的后期互动模型都有128维嵌入.

blocks.en: 2.1 Contrastive Teacher Training
blocks.zh: 2.1 相互矛盾的教师培训

blocks.en: We use Qwen3.5 ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) as the backbone for our late-interaction models. Qwen3.5 uses a hybrid architecture consisting of gated full attention layers with a causal mask and recurrent Gated DeltaNet ( Yang et al., 2025 ) (GDN) layers. We disable the causal mask in the full attention layers, yielding a hybrid bidirectional-causal architecture. We initialize the 18B late-interaction model by pruning the last 20 layers from Qwen3.5-27B. This reduces the cost of distillation while maintaining a strong training signal.
blocks.zh: 我们使用Quen3.5(Quen Team,2026年)作为我们晚交模式的骨干. Quen3.5采用混合结构,由带因果面具的门式全关注层和反复出现的Gated DeltaNet(杨等人,2025年)(GDN)层组成. 我们在全注意力层中禁用因果面具,产生混合双向-因果结构. 我们从 Quen3.5-27B 中 推开最后的 20 层 来初始化 18B 的 后期交互模式 。 这降低了蒸馏的成本,同时保持了强大的训练信号.

blocks.en:
Our pair data is composed of 28 datasets which we further partition by language and domain to increase the difficulty of in-batch negatives. This yields 981 sub-datasets with 186M rows of query-document pairs in total, 88.3% of which are text-text pairs, 8.3% are text-image pairs and 3.4% are text-visual document pairs. Of the text-text pairs, 14M are synthesized by generating queries for specific passages in PDF documents from the FinePDFs ( Kydlíček et al., 2025 ) dataset.
During training, we adjust the sampling weights of each dataset to reach a data mixture of 56.5% text-text pairs 30.9% text-image pairs, and 12.6% text-visual document pairs. Following previous work ( Günther et al., 2023 ) , we sample full batches from the sub-datasets. Since many sub-datasets are domain or language slices of the same source dataset, we introduce a novel quasi-random sampling strategy to ensure that sub-datasets are sampled both (i) in proportions close to the intended mixture and (ii) at regular intervals across training steps, avoiding both long gaps and temporal clustering. The sampling should satisfy these properties not only at the level of sub-datasets but also at the source-dataset level. We achieve this by constructing a cumulative sampling distribution in which all sub-datasets from the same source occupy contiguous intervals and mapping a randomly shifted golden-ratio Kronecker sequence through its inverse CDF.
The sequence’s low-discrepancy coverage ( Kuipers and Niederreiter, 1974 , Chapter 2, Theorem 3.4) and structured return times ( Slater, 1950 ) apply at both levels, guaranteeing proportional, well-spaced sampling of individual slices and their parent sources. We illustrate this in Figure 1 .
blocks.zh:
我们的配对数据由28个数据集组成,我们进一步按语言和域进行分割,以增加批次负数的难度. 这样生成981个子数据集,共计186M行查询文档对,其中88.3%为文本文本对,8.3%为文本图像对,3.4%为文本视频文档对. 在文本配对中,14M是通过FinePDFs(Kydlček等人,2025年)数据集生成PDF文件中特定段落的查询而合成的.
在培训期间,我们调整了每个数据集的抽样权重,以达到56.5%的文本对30.9%的文本图像对和12.6%的文本-视觉文件对的数据混合. 经过之前的工作(Günther等人,2023年),我们从子数据集中采集了整批样本. 由于许多子数据集是同一个源数据集的域或语言切片,我们引入了一种新的准随机采样策略,以确保子数据集的采样既能(一)在接近预期混合物的比例上,又能(二)在训练步骤之间定期间隔,避免长时间的缺口和时间集群. 取样不仅应在子数据集一级,而且在源数据集一级满足这些特性。 我们通过构建一个累积的采样分布,其中来自同一来源的所有子数据集占据毗连的间隔,并通过它的反向CDF绘制随机移动的金角克龙克序列图.
序列的低差覆盖率(Kuipers and Niederreiter,1974年,第2章,定理3.4)和结构化的返回时间(Slater,1950年)都适用于这两个级别,保证对单个切片及其母源进行比例化,分布良好的取样. 我们在图1中说明了这一点。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Comparison of our sampling method with independent random sampling according to the dataset weights.
blocks.zh: 图1:根据数据集权重,将我们的取样方法与独立的随机取样方法进行比较。

blocks.en:
We train the model with LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) on all attention and feed-forward projections to stabilize training and mitigate catastrophic forgetting. The adapters have rank 128.
Our training objective is the InfoNCE loss with a contrastive batch size of 16,384 query-document pairs. Following ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , we mask in-batch negatives based on a margin of 0.2 to the query-positive MaxSim score. During training, we truncate queries to 256 tokens and documents to 1,000 tokens, and resize images to at most 917,504 pixels while preserving their original aspect ratios.
To enable the large contrastive batch size, we use gradient caching ( Gao et al., 2021 ) and implement the MaxSim operation as a custom Triton ( Tillet et al., 2019 ) kernel to avoid materializing token-level similarity matrices. This work was concurrent with the efficient MaxSim implementations by Pony et al. (2026) ; Sharma (2026) ; Lac and Wu (2026) .
blocks.zh:
我们与LORA(Hu等人,2022年)一起对模型进行所有关注和反馈预测,以稳定培训和减轻灾难性的遗忘。 适配器有128级.
我们的培训目标是InfoNCE损失,相对的批量尺寸为16,384个查询文件对。 之后(张等人,2025年),我们以0.2的比分掩盖了内置负数,达到查询阳性马克思辛得分. 在培训期间,我们将查询的256个信使和文档缩短到1 000个信使,并将图像的大小调整到最多917 504像素,同时保留其原有的方格比。
为了能够实现大对比量批量大小,我们使用梯度缓冲(Gao et al., 2021),并作为定制的Triton(Tillet et al., 2019)内核执行MaxSim操作,以避免实现符号级相似矩阵. 这项工作与Pony等人(2026年)、Sharma (2026年)、Lac和Wu (2026年)高效实施MaxSim同时进行。

blocks.en: After pair training, we merge the LoRA weights into the backbone and add a new adapter with rank 32. We freeze the vision tower and train only on text triplets. We use at most four hard negatives per query and contrast each positive against its corresponding hard negatives and all other in-batch documents. Our triplet data is composed of public triplet datasets, mined hard negatives, and synthetic triplets created by modifying key information in highly templated documents.
blocks.zh: 成对训练后,将LORA权重合并到骨干中,并新增32级适配器. 我们冻结了视觉塔 只训练三进制文本 我们每次查询最多使用4个硬底片,并将每个正底片与相应的硬底片和所有其他夹层文件对比. 我们的三胞胎数据由公共三胞胎数据集, 挖掘硬底, 和合成三胞胎组成,

blocks.en: 2.2 Representation Distillation
blocks.zh: 2.2 代表人数减少

blocks.en: To distill our 18B teacher model down to 0.6B and 9B student models, we train the students to reproduce the teacher’s token-level representations by minimizing the Euclidean distance between corresponding ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -normalized embeddings. We average these distances over unmasked query and document positions separately, then combine the two averages with equal weight. The teacher remains frozen, so gradients update only the student. We let 𝒬 \mathcal{Q} and 𝒟 \mathcal{D} denote the unmasked query-token and document-token positions across the batch and indicate student and teacher embeddings by superscripts S S and T T . With 𝐪 i ​ t \mathbf{q}_{it} and 𝐝 i ​ t \mathbf{d}_{it} denoting query and document embeddings at token position t t of example i i within the batch, we formulate the loss as: ℒ = 1 | 𝒬 | ​ ∑ ( i , t ) ∈ 𝒬 ‖ 𝐪 i ​ t S − 𝐪 i ​ t T ‖ 2 + 1 | 𝒟 | ​ ∑ ( i , t ) ∈ 𝒟 ‖ 𝐝 i ​ t S − 𝐝 i ​ t T ‖ 2 . \mathcal{L}=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{Q}|}\sum_{(i,t)\in\mathcal{Q}}\left\|\mathbf{q}_{it}^{\mathrm{S}}-\mathbf{q}_{it}^{\mathrm{T}}\right\|_{2}+\frac{1}{|\mathcal{D}|}\sum_{(i,t)\in\mathcal{D}}\left\|\mathbf{d}_{it}^{\mathrm{S}}-\mathbf{d}_{it}^{\mathrm{T}}\right\|_{2}. Since this loss is not contrastive, we can mix sub-datasets when sampling a batch to reduce gradient noise without weakening our training signal.

blocks.en:
We use Qwen3.5-9B with bidirectional full attention as the backbone for our 9B late-interaction model. Unlike during contrastive training of the 18B model, LoRA does not appear to provide sufficient capacity to achieve satisfactory downstream performance with representation distillation. We hypothesize that this is caused by the constraints imposed on the embedding space by the distillation objective.
To increase capacity while limiting catastrophic forgetting, we fully fine-tune the last eight layers of the text tower while applying LoRA to the remaining projections.
blocks.zh:
我们使用双向全心全意的Quen3.5-9B作为我们9B晚交模式的骨干. 与18B型的对比性训练不同,LORA似乎没有提供足够的能力,通过表现蒸馏来达到令人满意的下游性能. 我们假设这是由蒸馏目标对嵌入空间施加的限制造成的。
为了提高容量,同时限制灾难性的遗忘,我们充分调整了文字塔的最后八层,同时将LORA应用于剩余的预测.

blocks.en:
The 0.6B late-interaction model is initialized from a pruned version of Qwen3.5-0.8B with bidirectional full attention layers.
Within each block of Qwen3.5-0.8B, we prune two of the three GDN layers, producing an architecture that alternates between gated full attention and GDN layers.
The resulting model has 594M parameters in total, of which 100M are used for image encoding and 254M are in the token-embedding table. Hence, only about 240M parameters are active for text encoding and 340M for image encoding. This small size allows deployment on edge devices.
We find that, especially on VDR tasks, full fine-tuning of the 0.6B backbone outperforms parameter-efficient approaches. Hence, in contrast to the 18B and 9B models, we fine-tune all parameters.
blocks.zh:
0.6B的后期交互模型是从一个被pruned版本的Quen3.5-0.8B初始化的,带有双向全注意力层.
在Quen3.5-0.8B的每个区块中,我们推开三层GDN中的两层,生成一个结构,将全注意力与GDN层相取代。
由此产生的模型共有594M参数,其中100M用于图像编码,254M位于符号-嵌入表. 因此,只有大约240M参数用于文本编码,340M用于图像编码. 这种小尺寸允许在边缘设备上部署.
我们发现,特别是在VDR任务方面,0.6B主干线的全面微调优于参数效率高的方法。 因此,与18B和9B模型相比,我们微调了所有参数。

blocks.en: 3 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3 评价

blocks.en:
We evaluate on various text-only and text-to-image benchmarks. We present results on single-hop and agentic retrieval tasks.
We excluded any training data that overlaps with evaluated tasks.
blocks.zh:
我们评价各种只有文本和文本到图像的基准。 我们介绍单跳和代理检索任务的结果。
我们排除了与评价任务重叠的任何培训数据。

blocks.en: 3.1 Text retrieval
blocks.zh: 3.1 文本检索

blocks.en:
For text retrieval, we evaluate a collection of 72 public tasks across six domains: finance (18 tasks), legal (20), health (8), conversation (5), tech (4), and multilingual (17), which we bundle into an internal domain-specific benchmark . Additionally, we evaluate the text version of ViDoRe-V3 ( Loison et al., 2026 ) and the Q2D-Web ( Schall et al., 2026 ) benchmark.
Text baselines include Nemotron 3 Embed 8B ( NVIDIA, 2026 ) , Qwen3 Embedding ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , Gemini Embedding 2 ( Shanbhogue et al., 2026 ) , and Voyage 4 ( Voyage AI, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
为了检索文本,我们评估了涉及六个领域的72项公共任务:财务(18项任务)、法律(20项)、保健(8项)、对话(5项)、技术(4项)和多语种(17项),我们把这些任务组合成一个内部特定领域的基准。 此外,我们评价ViDoRe-V3(Loison等人,2026年)和Q2D-Web(Schall等人,2026年)基准的文本版本。
文字基线包括Nemotron 3 Embed 8B(NVIDIA,2026年),Qune3 Embedding(张等人,2025年),双子Embedding. 2 (Shanbhogue等人, 2026), Voyage 4 (Voyage AI, 2026).

blocks.en: The domain-specific collection is built from public datasets such as FinQA ( Chen et al., 2021 ) , AILACasedocs ( Bhattacharya et al., 2020 ) and XLSum ( Hasan et al., 2021 ) . We do not disclose the full task list to reduce the risk of future models being tuned to it; as a result, these scores cannot be independently reproduced. pplx-embed-v2-late-9b averages 81.3% nDCG@10, 1.6 pp above the next best model, and scores highest on every domain except health, where nemotron-3-embed-8b and voyage-4-large score higher. pplx-embed-v2-late-0.6b averages 78.0% and scores highest among models with fewer than 1B parameters on every domain (Table 1 ).
blocks.zh: 具体域名的收集来自公共数据集,如FinQA(Chen等人,2021年),AILACasedocs (Bhattacharya等人,2020年)和XLSum(Hasan等人,2021年). 我们不公布全部任务清单,以减少调整未来模式的风险;因此,这些分数不能独立复制。 pplx-embed-v2-late-9b 平均值 81.3% nDCG@10,1.6页以上是次佳模型,在每个领域得分最高,但健康领域除外,其中Nemotron-3-embed-8b和航行-4-大得分较高. pplx-embed-v2-late-0.6b 平均78.0%,在每个域参数低于1B的模型中得分最高(表1).

blocks.en: Table 1: Domain-specific text retrieval performance (nDCG@10, %). The average weights the six domains equally; parentheses show the number of tasks in each domain. Dim. is the embedding dimension (per token for multi-vector models). Best score per column in bold.

blocks.en: The Q2D-Web benchmark contains about 70,000 agent-reformulated queries from production search traffic over a corpus of 190M web documents. Because it targets first-stage retrieval, we report Recall@1000. Relevance is judged in three ways: documents cited by the agent (Citation), documents ranked highly by our production retrieval system (Web), and the union of both extended with LLM judgments (Combined). We focus on Combined, which reduces bias towards models that rank similarly to the production system. On Combined, the 9B and 0.6B models score 74.8% and 73.6%, compared with 69.3% for the strongest baseline (Table 2 ).
blocks.zh: Q2D-Web基准包含大约70,000个代理调整的查询,来自190M网络文件的生产搜索流量。 因为它的目标是第一阶段检索,我们报告Recall@1000. 对相关性的判断有三种方式:代理商引用的文件(Citation),我们制作检索系统(Web)对文件的高度排名,以及两者与LLM判断的结合(Combined). 我们侧重于组合,这减少了对与生产系统类似的模型的偏向。 综合起来,9B和0.6B模型得分为74.8%和73.6%,而最强基线为69.3%(表2)。

blocks.en: Table 2: Text retrieval on the public subset of ViDoRe-V3 after converting page images to Markdown with OCR (average nDCG@10, %) and on Q2D-Web (Recall@1000, %) under three relevance judgment sets. Dim. is the embedding dimension (per token for multi-vector models). topk-embed-v1 ViDoRe-V3 scores are taken from the model cards ( TopK, 2026a ; TopK, 2026b ) at 128 dimensions; on Q2D-Web, these models were evaluated with an output dimension of 128. – denotes not evaluated. blocks.zh: 表2:在用OCR(平均nDCG@10,%)和Q2D-Web(召回@1000,%)将页面图像转换成Markdown后,在ViDoRe-V3的公开子集上进行文本检索. Dim.是嵌入维度(每个符号用于多载体模型). 顶部嵌入式v1 ViDoRe-V3的分数取自128维的型号卡(TopK,2026a;TopK,2026b);在Q2D-Web上,这些型号的输出维度为128. - 表示未评估。 每栏最佳分数用粗体表示.

blocks.en: On the Markdown version of ViDoRe-V3 (Table 2 ), both pplx-embed-v2-late models outperform all evaluated baselines, with the 9B model more than 4 pp above the best competitor.
blocks.zh: 在Markdown版本的ViDoRe-V3(表2)上,两个pplx-embed-v2-late模型都超过了所有评价的基线,9B模型在最佳竞争者之上超过4pp.

blocks.en: 3.2 Text-to-image retrieval
blocks.zh: 3.2 文本到图像检索

blocks.en:
Our primary VDR benchmark is the image version of ViDoRe-V3. We compare against dense (qwen3-vl-embed-8b ( Li et al., 2026 ) , gemini-embedding-2) and late-interaction (topk-embed-v1 0.8B and 2B) vision-language models, and against two vision-only late-interaction model families trained specifically for image retrieval (EVIE ( Wang et al., 2026 ) and Nemotron ColEmbed V2 ( de Souza P. Moreira et al., 2026 ) ).
Among vision-language models, pplx-embed-v2-late-9b and pplx-embed-v2-late-0.6b have the two highest averages. pplx-embed-v2-late-9b scores 65.2%, below EVIE-8B (66.4%) and EVIE-4.5B (65.9%), which have output dimensions of 4,096 and 2,048 per token, respectively, compared to pplx-embed-v2-late ’s output dimension of 128. pplx-embed-v2-late-0.6b scores 62.3%, 0.9 pp below topk-embed-v1-2b at its full width of 2,048 dimensions per token and 0.4 pp above it at 128 dimensions, 3.3 pp higher than topk-embed-v1-0.8b at 128 dimensions.
blocks.zh:
我们的主要VDR基准是ViDoRe-V3的图像版本. 我们比较了密度(qwen3-vl-embed-8b(Li等人,2026年),Gemini-embedding-2)和晚交(topk-embed-v1 0.8B和2B)的视觉语言模型,以及两个专门为图像检索而培训的仅视效晚交模式家庭(EVIE(Wang等人,2026年)和Nemotron Colembed V2(de Souza P. Moreira等人,2026年))。
在视觉语言模型中,pplx-embed-v2-late-9b和pplx-embed-v2-late-0.6b的平均值是两个最高的. pplx-embed-v2-late-9b的分数为65.2%,低于EVIE-8B(66.4%)和EVIE-4.5B(65.9%),其输出维度分别为每令牌4,096和2,048,而pplx-embed-v2-late的输出维度为128. pplx-embed-v2-late-0.6b的分数为62.3%,在顶端-embed-v1-2b下方0.9pp,全宽为每令牌2,048维,在128维上方0.4pp,在128维时比顶端-embed-v1-0.8b高3.3pp.

blocks.en: Table 3: Text-to-image retrieval (nDCG@10, %) on the public subset of ViDoRe-V3 (average), MIRACL-Vision and PPLX-Q2I. Vision-only models are trained specifically for image retrieval and are listed separately from vision-language models. Dim. is the embedding dimension (per token for multi-vector models). Nemotron ColEmbed and EVIE models were not evaluated on PPLX-Q2I because their high output dimensionality makes indexing impractical; – denotes not evaluated. Best score per column in bold.
blocks.zh: 表3:ViDoRe-V3(平均),MIRACL-Vision和PPLX-Q2I的公共子集上的文本到图像检索(nDCG@10,%). 专为图像检索而专门培训的唯景模型,与视觉语言模型分开列出. Dim.是嵌入维度(每个符号用于多载体模型). Nemotron ColEmbed 和 EVIE 模型没有在 PPLX-Q2I 上被评价,因为其高输出维度使得索引不切实际; – 表示没有被评价. 每栏最佳分数用粗体表示.

blocks.en: The MIRACL-Vision benchmark ( Osmulski et al., 2025 ) consists of a corpus of Wikipedia article screenshots. On this task, the vision-only Nemotron ColEmbed V2 4B and 8B models score 62.7% and 68.6%, respectively; pplx-embed-v2-late-0.6b scores 67.5% and pplx-embed-v2-late-9b scores 75.7%, 1.8 percentage points below the highest-scoring model, gemini-embedding-2 (Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: MIRACL-Vision基准(Osmulski等人,2025年)由维基百科文章截图集组成. 在这一任务上,仅视差的Nemotron ColEmbed V2 4B和8B模型分别得分62.7%和68.6%;pplx-embed-v2-late-0.6b得分67.5%和pplx-embed-v2-late-9b得分75.7%,比最高得分模型Gemini-embeding-2低1.8个百分点(表3).

blocks.en: PPLX-Q2I is built from production image-search logs, with 10,000 queries and 100,000 images (both visual documents and natural images); a query’s relevant images are those served for it in production. The 0.6B and 9B pplx-embed-v2-late models score 60.4% and 65.0%, compared with 67.0% for gemini-embedding-2 and 50.6% for qwen3-vl-embedding-8b (Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: PPLX-Q2I是用生产图像搜索日志建造的,有10,000个查询和100,000个图像(既包括视觉文件,也包括自然图像);一个查询的相关图像是制作中提供给它的. 0.6B和9B pplx-embed-v2-late模型得分分别为60.4%和65.0%,而Gemini-embeding-2为67.0%,qwen3-vl-embedding-8b为50.6%(表3)。

blocks.zh: 图2:跨模型检索 nDCG@10,用于3个查询/文档模型配对. 六个文本领域的结果。

blocks.en: 3.3 Cross-model retrieval
blocks.zh: 3.3 跨型号检索

blocks.en: Because the two models share an embedding space, a corpus can be indexed with the 9B model and queried with the 0.6B model, keeping query encoding cost the same as in the 0.6B → \rightarrow 0.6B setting. We illustrate this in Figure 2 on the domain-specific benchmarks. The 0.6B → \rightarrow 9B setting scores higher than 0.6B → \rightarrow 0.6B on every domain, by 1.6 pp on the domain average. The 9B → \rightarrow 9B setting scores highest at 81.3%. The hybrid setting thus improves retrieval performance without increasing query encoding cost.
blocks.zh: 由于两个模型共享嵌入空间,一个实体可以与9B模型进行索引,并用0.6B模型进行询问,使查询编码的成本与0.6B →\右旋0.6B设置相同. 我们在关于具体领域基准的图2中说明了这一点。 0.6B → 右键 9B 设置得分高于 0.6B → 右键 0.6B 在每个域上,在域平均值上为 1.6 pp. 9B =\右旋9B 设定最高分81.3%。 因此混合设置在不增加查询编码成本的情况下提高了检索性能.

blocks.en: 3.4 Agentic retrieval
blocks.zh: 3.4 代理检索

blocks.en: In BrowseComp+ ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , an LLM agent (GPT-OSS-120B ( OpenAI, 2025 ) , high effort) answers complex queries by searching a corpus with the embedding model under test, and a second LLM judges the answers. Both pplx-embed-v2-late models achieve higher accuracy with fewer searches than all evaluated baselines (Figure 3 ). The 9B model reaches 64.0% accuracy, 4.9 pp above Reason-ModernColBERT ( Chaffin, 2025b ) , the only other late-interaction model evaluated, and 8.7 pp above the best dense model, voyage-4-large.
blocks.zh: 在Browscomp+(Chen等人,2026年)中,LLM代理(GPT-OSS-120B(OpenAI,2025年),高功率)通过在测试中搜索嵌入模型的元件来回答复杂的询问,第二个LM判断答案. 两种pplx-embed-v2-late模型的精确度都高于所有评估基线(图3 )。 9B型达到64.0%的精度,上方4.9页Reason-Modern ColBERT (Chaffin, 2025b ),被评价的唯一另一个后期互动模式,和8.7页以上最稠密模式,航向-4-大.

blocks.en: Figure 3: BrowseComp+ accuracy and recall versus the average number of searches (GPT-OSS-120B agent, high effort).
blocks.zh: 图3:浏览Comp+的准确性和召回性与平均搜索次数(GPT-OSS-120B代理,高功率)对比.

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en:
We presented pplx-embed-v2-late , a pair of 0.6B and 9B multimodal, multilingual late-interaction models distilled at the representation level from a contrastively trained 18B teacher.
On our domain-specific text benchmarks, Q2D-Web and the Markdown version of ViDoRe-V3, both models outperform all evaluated baselines compared, to other models of their size. On ViDoRe-V3 image retrieval, they have the highest averages among vision-language models, while vision-only EVIE models score higher.
Because both students are trained to match the same teacher, they share an embedding space: indexing with the 9B model and querying with the 0.6B model improves over using the 0.6B model alone, at the same query encoding cost.
In agentic retrieval, both models reach higher BrowseComp+ accuracy with fewer searches than all evaluated baselines.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了pplx-embed-v2-late, 一对0.6B和9B的多式、多语种的后期互动模型,这些模型是在代表级别上从一个相对训练有素的18B教师那里提炼出来的。
在我们的域特定文本基准上,Q2D-Web和Markdown版本的ViDoRe-V3,这两个模型都比所有评价的基线都好,而其他模型的大小则不同。 在ViDoRe-V3图像检索上,他们在视觉语言模型中的平均值最高,而只有视觉的EVIE模型得分较高.
由于两个学生都经过了训练来匹配同一个老师,他们共享一个嵌入空间:与9B模型进行索引,与0.6B模型进行查询,比仅使用0.6B模型有所改善,同样使用查询编码成本.
在代理检索中,两种模型都达到了更高的浏览性Comp+精度,搜索比所有评估的基线都少.
